meta.move: Written by the lead after attempt 1 (not blind): owns the zero, shows each piece by saying so, answers each defence in a sentence, offers 4.4, sets a date
meta.expect: She reaches the deal after Hale offers 4.4; she never proposes the rewrite herself

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided on the zero, Hale, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
Thanks for coming in. Before anything else: I entered the zero on November 3 without calling you first. That was wrong, and Owen shouldn't have found out on his phone.
Okay. Was Owen heard before you entered it?

I've turned my laptop to you. This is the document's version history: created Wednesday, October 28, at 11:31 PM with a title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words appear in one edit. At 11:58 PM, another 794 words in one edit. No earlier drafts.
I'm writing those times down. Pasting a draft in from somewhere else proves nothing about who wrote it.
If he drafted it somewhere else, he can bring that draft with its date and I'll look at it. Until then, this record is what we have.
Is anything on his record right now, Hale? Whatever comes of this, it stays off it, and it stays quiet.
Here's the essay, page two, and here's the play open to Act 3, Scene 2. The essay quotes 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' Search the scene yourself; it isn't there.
A misquoted line is a careless student, not a cheating one. And you haven't answered me about his record.
A misquote from memory is usually close to a real line. This one isn't close to anything in the play.
Fine. Yes or no, Hale: is anything on his record, and what exactly are you proposing?
Here's his October 15 outline beside the essay. The outline argues Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay argues epistemological paralysis and never mentions cowardice.
People change their argument in two weeks; that's called thinking. You've dodged my question twice now.

Here's what I can offer under procedure 4.4: a private supervised rewrite, after school, not in front of his class, before December 1. The new mark replaces the zero, and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.
Then he'll do the rewrite, to put this behind him, and nothing more. Private, before December 1, nothing on file, and I'll have that from you in writing tonight.
Thursday the twelfth after school works for me. Does that work for Owen?
I'll confirm Thursday with Owen tonight. Put the date in your email.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed to a private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4, after school and not in front of his class, before December 1, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on Owen's record. I still require a direct answer as to whether anything is on his record now, and confirmation of the rewrite date. I expect that in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Last position: she agreed to a private supervised rewrite before December 1, and she still wants your written confirmation tonight and a straight answer on whether anything is on his record now; that is the fair outcome, procedure 4.4, reached before her time ran out.
What moved her: You showed the version history with its late-night times and answered her paste-from-elsewhere defence by inviting a dated draft, which gave her something she could check rather than a machine's score.
What cost ground: You twice skipped her question about whether anything was already on his record, which made her sharper and kept her from easing until you finally committed to nothing going on file.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM, saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history landed on a late October night just before the essay was due, very close to that memory; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked whether anything was on his record, answer it plainly in one sentence before showing the outline, so her biggest fear is settled early.
